title: Documentation of the frozen contracts and the 1.0.0 release notes
summary: Documents every frozen contract for consumers and implementers — a compatibility promise page (Api vs Spi Implement/Call, closed/open enums, named arguments, what counts as a break, baseline and stable tags) and a machine-formats reference (exception codes, event types and payload keys, journal rows, doctor checks/finding ids/severities/JSON, explain JSON, commands/options/exit codes, publish tags, migration basenames, config keys/defaults/environment names, HTTP mapping) — guarded by `tests/Arch/FormatsDocumentedTest.php`, which reads the fixtures; writes the CHANGELOG `[1.0.0]` section.
why: Condition 8 needs documentation for every frozen non-PHP contract and condition 10 a stated promise; D25 makes [1.0.0] the first record. Hard risks: docs drifting from the fixtures (the test reads the fixtures, not a copy); a promise wider than the comparator enforces; release notes that read as a continuation of 0.x.

include: `docs/reference/compatibility.md`: the promise of knowledge/architecture#api-compatibility as enforced by p4-execution#compatibility (rule table in prose), SemVer for both packages, how to read `#[Api]`/`#[Spi]`/`@internal`/`@closed`/`@open`/`@no-named-arguments`, the baseline (stable tags) — no plan or decision ids

`docs/reference/formats.md` (new) for doctor JSON, explain JSON, resources (publish tags, migration basenames, generated-migration patterns, aliases, plugin ids, system actor type), environment names and the HTTP mapping (403 without details, `DecisionResponder`); extend `commands.md`, `configuration.md`, `events.md`, `exceptions.md` where an identity of the fixtures is missing

`tests/Arch/FormatsDocumentedTest.php`: every exception code, event type string and payload key, doctor check key and finding id, command name/option/exit-code label, publish tag, migration basename, config key path and environment name from the fixtures appears in `docs/reference/*.md`; negative control with a fabricated identity

`CHANGELOG.md`: `## [1.0.0] - <YYYY-MM-DD>` (the planned freeze date; P4.8 corrects it if the freeze lands later) from the P4.1 draft: first public release, requirements (PHP 8.3–8.5, Laravel 11–13, Filament 5 for the Filament package), Added summary per package/module, a 'Stability' paragraph pointing at docs/reference/compatibility.md; `[1.0.0]` link to the release tag URL; empty `[Unreleased]` above it
`docs/modules/*`, `docs/advanced/hooks-and-plugins.md`: link to the compatibility page where they describe SPI
exclude: Plan, decision or phase identifiers in public docs
Changing any identity to match the docs (docs follow the fixtures)

reads.why: Rules every P4 item follows: demonstrated fixes only, stop rule for frozen contracts, 1.0 starting point, owner WIP, pushes, long runs, evidence
Exact commands, PHP 8.4 shim, driver ports, composer update rule, CI evidence procedure
The amended release conditions and which evidence this item contributes
What is stable: consumer vs implementer, named arguments, additions, enums, formats, generator and comparison
The rules the promise page describes
How the section becomes release notes

rules: Do not stage, revert or overwrite the owner's uncommitted files (p4-execution#conventions item 6); commit only the item's paths.
Docs language and PHP-version gates apply (bin/docs-language-gate.sh, bin/docs-php-version-gate.sh).
guidance: Generate the identity lists for the test from the fixtures with small readers (reuse the fixture structure seen in p4-execution#compatibility); match identities as code spans (`` `azguard:doctor` ``) to avoid accidental prose matches.

validation.expect: exit 0 (if Node is not available to the agent, the CI Docs job in P4.8 is the evidence)

validation.cmd: bash bin/release-preflight.sh 1.0.0 HEAD && bash bin/release-notes.sh 1.0.0 HEAD > /dev/null
